entities.name: Louise Adélaïde d'Orléans
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louise Adélaïde d'Orléans was the second daughter of Philippe d'Orléans and Françoise Marie de Bourbon, a legitimised daughter of Louis XIV and his mistress, Madame de Montespan. She was an Abbess of Chelles.
